name: qlrisk_price_commodity_option
title: Price a CommodityOption
description:
Price one Commodity Option (qlrisk CommodityOption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, option_type=call (call/put), strike, quantity, commodity=WTI, convenience_yield_pct=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 121,749.11 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
